structure.engage: Show a rock, toy, and book.\nAsk: ""What do these have in common?""
structure.explore: Sort objects into solids/non-solids.\nTest hardness with a spoon.
structure.elaborate: Build a ""solid tower"" with blocks.\nPredict which shapes stack best.
structure.evaluate: Draw a solid object.\nExplain why itï¿½s a solid.

notes.teacherNotes: Use tactile objects for ESL students.\nHighlight safety with hard objects.

structure.engage: Pour water, oil, and syrup.\nAsk: ""Which flows fastest?""
structure.explore: Time liquid flow on slopes.\nRecord results.
structure.explain: Discuss viscosity and fluidity.\nShow liquid particle model.
structure.elaborate: Design a ""liquid race"" track.\nTest different liquids.
structure.evaluate: Match liquids to real-world uses (e.g., honey in sandwiches).

structure.explore: Capture air in bags.\nObserve bubbles in soda.
structure.explain: Define gases (no fixed shape/volume).\nShow 3D gas particle model.
structure.elaborate: Simulate wind with a fan.\nPredict how gases move.

notes.teacherNotes: Use clear soda for visibility.\nAvoid latex allergies.

structure.engage: Show a potted plant.\nAsk: ""What parts do you see?""
structure.explore: Dissect a plant (roots, stem, leaves).\nUse magnifiers.
structure.explain: Explain each partï¿½s job.\nShow 3D plant anatomy model.
structure.evaluate: Match parts to functions (e.g., roots drink water).

notes.teacherNotes: Use fast-growing seeds (e.g., beans).\nAllocate roles in group work.

structure.engage: Ask: ""Whatï¿½s the weather today?""\nShow a weather report clip.
structure.explore: Record daily weather for a week.\nUse symbols (sun, cloud, rain).
structure.explain: Discuss weather types and causes.\nShow 3D water cycle model.
structure.elaborate: Predict tomorrowï¿½s weather.\nCompare with actual results.

notes.teacherNotes: Link to local weather patterns.\nUse a class weather station.

structure.engage: Strum a rubber band.\nAsk: ""What do you see/feel?""
structure.explore: Test sound makers (e.g., drums, shakers).\nFeel vibrations.
structure.explain: Explain sound = vibrations.\nShow 3D sound wave model.
structure.elaborate: Make a DIY ""guitar"" with rubber bands and boxes.
structure.evaluate: Identify loud/soft sounds in the classroom.

structure.engage: Roll a ball down a plank.\nAsk: ""Did the slope change speed?""
structure.explore: Test ramp angles with toy cars.\nMeasure distance traveled.
structure.explain: Define ramps as simple machines.\nShow 3D ramp mechanics model.
structure.elaborate: Build a ""marble run"" with tubes and ramps.
structure.evaluate: Label ramps in everyday life (e.g., slides).
